exposure: imaging modalities (physical examination, transabdominal ultrasonography, computed tomography, magnetic resonance imaging)
hormonal therapy (dienogest, gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonists, oral contraceptives)
cohort: Ninety-six patients with pathologically diagnosed benign umbilical endometriosis and 2 cases of malignant transformation identified from 2006 to 2016.
finding: The study found a low recurrence rate following surgery for umbilical endometriosis, with no recurrence after wide resection, suggesting surgical therapy as the first choice of treatment.
